ASAM UI PRO

表格编辑与排序

提供行、单元格、批量编辑与受控排序。

使用与 API

  • 可编辑表格 · AsamEditableTable：直接在单元格中修改字段，通过 v-model 同步当前页数据。
  • 可排序编辑表格 · AsamSortableTable：独立调整行与列的顺序，按需开启单元格编辑。

完整示例

可编辑表格

单行编辑

点击一行的编辑按钮，修改字段后保存或取消。

vue
<template>
	<EditingDemo mode="single" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import EditingDemo from './EditingDemo.vue';
</script>
vue
<template>
	<section class="editing-demo">
		<AsamTableEditingHost
			:initial-mode="mode"
			:show-mode-switch="false"
			:show-control-size="false"
			:controller="editing"
			:columns="columns"
			:operation-id="createExampleOperationId"
			:persist-cell="persistCell"
			:confirm-discard="confirmDiscard"
		/>
	</section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
import { AsamMessageBox, createAsamDataRuntime, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import {
	AsamTableEditingHost,
	createAsamNumberField,
	createAsamWriteCoordinator,
	useAsamListController,
	useAsamTableEditing
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamCellChange,
	AsamEditableColumn,
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamTableEditingPresentation
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createExampleOperationId } from './OperationId.js';

defineProps<{ mode: AsamTableEditingPresentation }>();

interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	status: string;
	budget: number;
}

const statuses = ['待启动', '进行中', '已完成'];
const records: Row[] = [
	{ id: 1, name: '供应链协同平台', status: '进行中', budget: 48000 },
	{ id: 2, name: '园区设备巡检', status: '待启动', budget: 55500 },
	{ id: 3, name: '研发知识库升级', status: '进行中', budget: 63000 },
	{ id: 4, name: '客户服务工作台', status: '已完成', budget: 70500 }
];
const fields: AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		label: '项目名称',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: {
			edit: { rules: [{ required: true, whitespace: true, message: '请输入项目名称' }] }
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'status',
		label: '状态',
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: statuses.map((status) => ({ value: status, label: status }))
		})
	},
	createAsamNumberField({ key: 'budget', label: '预算（元）', min: 0, required: true })
];
const columns: AsamEditableColumn<Row>[] = [
	{ key: 'id', label: '编号', width: 112, draggable: false },
	{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', minWidth: 220 },
	{ key: 'status', label: '状态', minWidth: 120 },
	{ key: 'budget', label: '预算（元）', minWidth: 145 }
];

const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const list = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async () => ({ list: records.map((row) => ({ ...row })), total: records.length })
});

function confirmDiscard() {
	return AsamMessageBox.confirm('放弃尚未保存的内容？', '取消编辑', {
		confirmButtonText: '放弃修改',
		cancelButtonText: '继续编辑'
	}).then(
		() => true,
		() => false
	);
}

const editing = useAsamTableEditing<Row>({
	list,
	runtime,
	coordinator: createAsamWriteCoordinator(),
	fields,
	equals: { budget: Object.is },
	confirmDiscard,
	save: async (payload, operation) => {
		const row = records.find((item) => item.id === operation.target.id);
		if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '记录已不存在' };
		Object.assign(row, payload);
		return { status: 'success' };
	},
	saveOrder: async () => ({ status: 'failure', message: '本例只保存字段变更' })
});

async function persistCell(change: AsamCellChange<Row>) {
	if (!change.isCurrent()) return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '编辑已失效' };
	const row = records.find((item) => item.id === change.rowKey);
	if (!row) return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '记录已不存在' };
	Object.assign(row, { [change.columnKey]: change.value });
	return { status: 'success' as const };
}

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	editing.dispose();
	runtime.invalidate();
});
</script>
ts
/** 示例操作身份：优先原生 UUID；普通 HTTP 使用仍可用的 Web Crypto 强随机数。 */
export function createExampleOperationId(): string {
	const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
	if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
	if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues !== 'function')
		throw new Error('当前环境未提供 Web Crypto 安全随机数能力');
	const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
	bytes[6] = (bytes[6]! & 0x0f) | 0x40;
	bytes[8] = (bytes[8]! & 0x3f) | 0x80;
	const hex = Array.from(bytes, (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
	return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
}

	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamTableEditingPresentation
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createExampleOperationId } from './OperationId.js';

defineProps<{ mode: AsamTableEditingPresentation }>();

interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	status: string;
	budget: number;
}

const statuses = ['待启动', '进行中', '已完成'];
const records: Row[] = [
	{ id: 1, name: '供应链协同平台', status: '进行中', budget: 48000 },
	{ id: 2, name: '园区设备巡检', status: '待启动', budget: 55500 },
	{ id: 3, name: '研发知识库升级', status: '进行中', budget: 63000 },
	{ id: 4, name: '客户服务工作台', status: '已完成', budget: 70500 }
];
const fields: AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		label: '项目名称',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: {
			edit: { rules: [{ required: true, whitespace: true, message: '请输入项目名称' }] }
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'status',
		label: '状态',
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: statuses.map((status) => ({ value: status, label: status }))
		})
	},
	createAsamNumberField({ key: 'budget', label: '预算（元）', min: 0, required: true })
];
const columns: AsamEditableColumn<Row>[] = [
	{ key: 'id', label: '编号', width: 112, draggable: false },
	{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', minWidth: 220 },
	{ key: 'status', label: '状态', minWidth: 120 },
	{ key: 'budget', label: '预算（元）', minWidth: 145 }
];

const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const list = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async () => ({ list: records.map((row) => ({ ...row })), total: records.length })
});

function confirmDiscard() {
	return AsamMessageBox.confirm('放弃尚未保存的内容？', '取消编辑', {
		confirmButtonText: '放弃修改',
		cancelButtonText: '继续编辑'
	}).then(
		() => true,
		() => false
	);
}

const editing = useAsamTableEditing<Row>({
	list,
	runtime,
	coordinator: createAsamWriteCoordinator(),
	fields,
	equals: { budget: Object.is },
	confirmDiscard,
	save: async (payload, operation) => {
		const row = records.find((item) => item.id === operation.target.id);
		if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '记录已不存在' };
		Object.assign(row, payload);
		return { status: 'success' };
	},
	saveOrder: async () => ({ status: 'failure', message: '本例只保存字段变更' })
});

async function persistCell(change: AsamCellChange<Row>) {
	if (!change.isCurrent()) return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '编辑已失效' };
	const row = records.find((item) => item.id === change.rowKey);
	if (!row) return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '记录已不存在' };
	Object.assign(row, { [change.columnKey]: change.value });
	return { status: 'success' as const };
}

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	editing.dispose();
	runtime.invalidate();
});
</script>

/** 示例操作身份：优先原生 UUID；普通 HTTP 使用仍可用的 Web Crypto 强随机数。 */
export function createExampleOperationId(): string {
	const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
	if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
	if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues !== 'function')
		throw new Error('当前环境未提供 Web Crypto 安全随机数能力');
	const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
	bytes[6] = (bytes[6]! & 0x0f) | 0x40;
	bytes[8] = (bytes[8]! & 0x3f) | 0x80;
	const hex = Array.from(bytes, (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
	return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
}

vue
<template>
	<section class="component-project" data-demo-host>
		<label
			>演示场景<AsamSelect
				:model-value="selected"
				aria-label="演示场景"
				@update:model-value="selectScenario"
				><AsamOption
					v-for="option in options"
					:key="option.value"
					:value="option.value"
					:label="option.label" /></AsamSelect></label
		><AsamConfigProvider :button="{ type: 'primary' }"
			><AsamApplicationProvider :config="{ base: { i18n } }"
				><component :is="current" :key="selected" /></AsamApplicationProvider
		></AsamConfigProvider>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
const i18n = useAsamProI18n();
const options = [
	{ value: 'single/ts', label: '单行编辑 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'single/js', label: '单行编辑 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'multiple/ts', label: '多行编辑 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'multiple/js', label: '多行编辑 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'instant/ts', label: '即时编辑 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'instant/js', label: '即时编辑 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'cell/ts', label: '单元格编辑 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'cell/js', label: '单元格编辑 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'single/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/single/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'single/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/single/js/Demo.vue')),
	'multiple/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/multiple/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'multiple/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/multiple/js/Demo.vue')),
	'instant/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/instant/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'instant/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/instant/js/Demo.vue')),
	'cell/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cell/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'cell/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/cell/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('single/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>
<style scoped>
.component-project {
	display: grid;
	gap: 24px;
	padding: 24px;
}
.component-project label {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 12px;
}
.component-project .asam-select {
	width: min(100%, 420px);
}
</style>

<template>
	<section class="editing-demo">
		<AsamTableEditingHost
			:initial-mode="mode"
			:show-mode-switch="false"
			:show-control-size="false"
			:controller="editing"
			:columns="columns"
			:operation-id="createExampleOperationId"
			:persist-cell="persistCell"
			:confirm-discard="confirmDiscard"
		/>
	</section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
import { AsamMessageBox, createAsamDataRuntime, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import {
	AsamTableEditingHost,
	createAsamNumberField,
	createAsamWriteCoordinator,
	useAsamListController,
	useAsamTableEditing
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamCellChange,
	AsamEditableColumn,
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamTableEditingPresentation
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createExampleOperationId } from './OperationId.js';

defineProps<{ mode: AsamTableEditingPresentation }>();

interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	status: string;
	budget: number;
}

const statuses = ['待启动', '进行中', '已完成'];
const records: Row[] = [
	{ id: 1, name: '供应链协同平台', status: '进行中', budget: 48000 },
	{ id: 2, name: '园区设备巡检', status: '待启动', budget: 55500 },
	{ id: 3, name: '研发知识库升级', status: '进行中', budget: 63000 },
	{ id: 4, name: '客户服务工作台', status: '已完成', budget: 70500 }
];
const fields: AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		label: '项目名称',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: {
			edit: { rules: [{ required: true, whitespace: true, message: '请输入项目名称' }] }
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'status',
		label: '状态',
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: statuses.map((status) => ({ value: status, label: status }))
		})
	},
	createAsamNumberField({ key: 'budget', label: '预算（元）', min: 0, required: true })
];
const columns: AsamEditableColumn<Row>[] = [
	{ key: 'id', label: '编号', width: 112, draggable: false },
	{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', minWidth: 220 },
	{ key: 'status', label: '状态', minWidth: 120 },
	{ key: 'budget', label: '预算（元）', minWidth: 145 }
];

const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const list = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async () => ({ list: records.map((row) => ({ ...row })), total: records.length })
});

function confirmDiscard() {
	return AsamMessageBox.confirm('放弃尚未保存的内容？', '取消编辑', {
		confirmButtonText: '放弃修改',
		cancelButtonText: '继续编辑'
	}).then(
		() => true,
		() => false
	);
}

const editing = useAsamTableEditing<Row>({
	list,
	runtime,
	coordinator: createAsamWriteCoordinator(),
	fields,
	equals: { budget: Object.is },
	confirmDiscard,
	save: async (payload, operation) => {
		const row = records.find((item) => item.id === operation.target.id);
		if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '记录已不存在' };
		Object.assign(row, payload);
		return { status: 'success' };
	},
	saveOrder: async () => ({ status: 'failure', message: '本例只保存字段变更' })
});

async function persistCell(change: AsamCellChange<Row>) {
	if (!change.isCurrent()) return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '编辑已失效' };
	const row = records.find((item) => item.id === change.rowKey);
	if (!row) return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '记录已不存在' };
	Object.assign(row, { [change.columnKey]: change.value });
	return { status: 'success' as const };
}

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	editing.dispose();
	runtime.invalidate();
});
</script>
ts
/** 示例操作身份：优先原生 UUID；普通 HTTP 使用仍可用的 Web Crypto 强随机数。 */
export function createExampleOperationId(): string {
	const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
	if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
	if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues !== 'function')
		throw new Error('当前环境未提供 Web Crypto 安全随机数能力');
	const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
	bytes[6] = (bytes[6]! & 0x0f) | 0x40;
	bytes[8] = (bytes[8]! & 0x3f) | 0x80;
	const hex = Array.from(bytes, (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
	return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
}

import {
	AsamTableEditingHost,
	createAsamNumberField,
	createAsamWriteCoordinator,
	useAsamListController,
	useAsamTableEditing
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamCellChange,
	AsamEditableColumn,
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamTableEditingPresentation
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createExampleOperationId } from './OperationId.js';

defineProps<{ mode: AsamTableEditingPresentation }>();

interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	status: string;
	budget: number;
}

const statuses = ['待启动', '进行中', '已完成'];
const records: Row[] = [
	{ id: 1, name: '供应链协同平台', status: '进行中', budget: 48000 },
	{ id: 2, name: '园区设备巡检', status: '待启动', budget: 55500 },
	{ id: 3, name: '研发知识库升级', status: '进行中', budget: 63000 },
	{ id: 4, name: '客户服务工作台', status: '已完成', budget: 70500 }
];
const fields: AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{
		key: 'name',
		label: '项目名称',
		kind: 'text',
		modes: {
			edit: { rules: [{ required: true, whitespace: true, message: '请输入项目名称' }] }
		}
	},
	{
		key: 'status',
		label: '状态',
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: statuses.map((status) => ({ value: status, label: status }))
		})
	},
	createAsamNumberField({ key: 'budget', label: '预算（元）', min: 0, required: true })
];
const columns: AsamEditableColumn<Row>[] = [
	{ key: 'id', label: '编号', width: 112, draggable: false },
	{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', minWidth: 220 },
	{ key: 'status', label: '状态', minWidth: 120 },
	{ key: 'budget', label: '预算（元）', minWidth: 145 }
];

const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const list = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async () => ({ list: records.map((row) => ({ ...row })), total: records.length })
});

function confirmDiscard() {
	return AsamMessageBox.confirm('放弃尚未保存的内容？', '取消编辑', {
		confirmButtonText: '放弃修改',
		cancelButtonText: '继续编辑'
	}).then(
		() => true,
		() => false
	);
}

const editing = useAsamTableEditing<Row>({
	list,
	runtime,
	coordinator: createAsamWriteCoordinator(),
	fields,
	equals: { budget: Object.is },
	confirmDiscard,
	save: async (payload, operation) => {
		const row = records.find((item) => item.id === operation.target.id);
		if (!row) return { status: 'failure', message: '记录已不存在' };
		Object.assign(row, payload);
		return { status: 'success' };
	},
	saveOrder: async () => ({ status: 'failure', message: '本例只保存字段变更' })
});

async function persistCell(change: AsamCellChange<Row>) {
	if (!change.isCurrent()) return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '编辑已失效' };
	const row = records.find((item) => item.id === change.rowKey);
	if (!row) return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '记录已不存在' };
	Object.assign(row, { [change.columnKey]: change.value });
	return { status: 'success' as const };
}

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	editing.dispose();
	runtime.invalidate();
});
</script>
ts
/** 示例操作身份：优先原生 UUID；普通 HTTP 使用仍可用的 Web Crypto 强随机数。 */
export function createExampleOperationId(): string {
	const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
	if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
	if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues !== 'function')
		throw new Error('当前环境未提供 Web Crypto 安全随机数能力');
	const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
	bytes[6] = (bytes[6]! & 0x0f) | 0x40;
	bytes[8] = (bytes[8]! & 0x3f) | 0x80;
	const hex = Array.from(bytes, (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
	return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
}

# AsamEditableTable 四模式TS/JS场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

<template>
	<div class="pro-example-stack">
		<p>{{ instructions[mode] }}</p>
		<AsamSortableTable
			v-model="rows"
			v-model:column-order="columnOrder"
			row-key="id"
			:columns="columns"
			:row-sortable="mode === 'rows'"
			:column-sortable="mode === 'columns'"
			:editable="false"
			v-model:border="border"
			@header-dragend="showWidthChange"
		/>
		<p v-if="mode === 'width'" role="status">{{ widthChange }}</p>
		<p v-else>{{ orderSummary }}</p>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSortableTable } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamEditableColumn } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

const props = defineProps<{ mode: 'rows' | 'columns' | 'width' }>();
type Row = { id: number; name: string; owner: string; status: string };
const instructions = {
	rows: '聚焦行首手柄后，可按 Alt + ↑ 或 Alt + ↓ 调整位置。',
	columns: '聚焦列标题后，可按 Alt + ← 或 Alt + → 调整位置。',
	width: '将鼠标移到可调整列的表头右边界，出现双向箭头后拖动。'
};
const rows = shallowRef<Row[]>([
	{ id: 1, name: '供应链协同平台', owner: '陈晨', status: '进行中' },
	{ id: 2, name: '园区设备巡检', owner: '林悦', status: '待启动' },
	{ id: 3, name: '研发知识库升级', owner: '张远', status: '已完成' },
	{ id: 4, name: '客户服务工作台', owner: '陈晨', status: '进行中' }
]);
const columnOrder = shallowRef(['id', 'name', 'owner', 'status']);
const columnDefinitions: AsamEditableColumn<Row>[] = [
	{ key: 'id', label: '项目编号', width: 92, fixed: 'left', draggable: false },
	{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', minWidth: 220 },
	{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', minWidth: 140 },
	{ key: 'status', label: '状态', minWidth: 140 }
];
const columns = computed(() =>
	columnDefinitions.map((column) => ({
		...column,
		resizable: props.mode === 'width' && column.key !== 'id'
	}))
);
const columnLabels = new Map<string, string>(
	columnDefinitions.map(({ key, label }) => [key, label])
);
const orderSummary = computed(() =>
	props.mode === 'rows'
		? '当前项目顺序：' + rows.value.map((row) => row.id).join(' → ')
		: '当前列顺序：' + columnOrder.value.map((key) => columnLabels.get(key)).join(' → ')
);
const border = shallowRef(props.mode === 'width');
const widthChange = shallowRef('');
function showWidthChange(newWidth: number, oldWidth: number) {
	widthChange.value = `列宽已从 ${Math.round(oldWidth)} px 调整到 ${Math.round(newWidth)} px。`;
}
</script>

vue
<template>
	<section class="component-project" data-demo-host>
		<label
			>演示场景<AsamSelect
				:model-value="selected"
				aria-label="演示场景"
				@update:model-value="selectScenario"
				><AsamOption
					v-for="option in options"
					:key="option.value"
					:value="option.value"
					:label="option.label" /></AsamSelect></label
		><AsamConfigProvider :button="{ type: 'primary' }"
			><AsamApplicationProvider
				><component :is="current" :key="selected" /></AsamApplicationProvider
		></AsamConfigProvider>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
const options = [
	{ value: 'rows/ts', label: '行拖动排序 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'rows/js', label: '行拖动排序 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'columns/ts', label: '列拖动排序 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'columns/js', label: '列拖动排序 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'width/ts', label: '列宽调整 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'width/js', label: '列宽调整 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'rows/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/rows/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'rows/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/rows/js/Demo.vue')),
	'columns/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/columns/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'columns/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/columns/js/Demo.vue')),
	'width/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/width/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'width/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/width/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('rows/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>

}

	gap: 12px;
}

}
</style>

<template>
	<div class="pro-example-stack">
		<p>{{ instructions[mode] }}</p>
		<AsamSortableTable
			v-model="rows"
			v-model:column-order="columnOrder"

			:columns="columns"
			:row-sortable="mode === 'rows'"
			:column-sortable="mode === 'columns'"
			:editable="false"
			v-model:border="border"
			@header-dragend="showWidthChange"
		/>
		<p v-if="mode === 'width'" role="status">{{ widthChange }}</p>
		<p v-else>{{ orderSummary }}</p>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSortableTable } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamEditableColumn } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

const props = defineProps<{ mode: 'rows' | 'columns' | 'width' }>();
type Row = { id: number; name: string; owner: string; status: string };
const instructions = {
	rows: '聚焦行首手柄后，可按 Alt + ↑ 或 Alt + ↓ 调整位置。',
	columns: '聚焦列标题后，可按 Alt + ← 或 Alt + → 调整位置。',
	width: '将鼠标移到可调整列的表头右边界，出现双向箭头后拖动。'
};
const rows = shallowRef<Row[]>([
	{ id: 1, name: '供应链协同平台', owner: '陈晨', status: '进行中' },
	{ id: 2, name: '园区设备巡检', owner: '林悦', status: '待启动' },
	{ id: 3, name: '研发知识库升级', owner: '张远', status: '已完成' },
	{ id: 4, name: '客户服务工作台', owner: '陈晨', status: '进行中' }
]);
const columnOrder = shallowRef(['id', 'name', 'owner', 'status']);
const columnDefinitions: AsamEditableColumn<Row>[] = [
	{ key: 'id', label: '项目编号', width: 92, fixed: 'left', draggable: false },
	{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', minWidth: 220 },
	{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', minWidth: 140 },
	{ key: 'status', label: '状态', minWidth: 140 }
];
const columns = computed(() =>
	columnDefinitions.map((column) => ({
		...column,
		resizable: props.mode === 'width' && column.key !== 'id'
	}))
);
const columnLabels = new Map<string, string>(
	columnDefinitions.map(({ key, label }) => [key, label])
);
const orderSummary = computed(() =>
	props.mode === 'rows'
		? '当前项目顺序：' + rows.value.map((row) => row.id).join(' → ')
		: '当前列顺序：' + columnOrder.value.map((key) => columnLabels.get(key)).join(' → ')
);
const border = shallowRef(props.mode === 'width');
const widthChange = shallowRef('');
function showWidthChange(newWidth: number, oldWidth: number) {
	widthChange.value = `列宽已从 ${Math.round(oldWidth)} px 调整到 ${Math.round(newWidth)} px。`;
}
</script>

		<p v-if="mode === 'width'" role="status">{{ widthChange }}</p>
		<p v-else>{{ orderSummary }}</p>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSortableTable } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
const props = defineProps({
	mode: { type: String, required: true }
});
const instructions = {
	rows: '聚焦行首手柄后，可按 Alt + ↑ 或 Alt + ↓ 调整位置。',
	columns: '聚焦列标题后，可按 Alt + ← 或 Alt + → 调整位置。',
	width: '将鼠标移到可调整列的表头右边界，出现双向箭头后拖动。'
};
const rows = shallowRef([
	{ id: 1, name: '供应链协同平台', owner: '陈晨', status: '进行中' },
	{ id: 2, name: '园区设备巡检', owner: '林悦', status: '待启动' },
	{ id: 3, name: '研发知识库升级', owner: '张远', status: '已完成' },
	{ id: 4, name: '客户服务工作台', owner: '陈晨', status: '进行中' }
]);
const columnOrder = shallowRef(['id', 'name', 'owner', 'status']);
const columnDefinitions = [
	{ key: 'id', label: '项目编号', width: 92, fixed: 'left', draggable: false },
	{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', minWidth: 220 },
	{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', minWidth: 140 },
	{ key: 'status', label: '状态', minWidth: 140 }
];
const columns = computed(() =>
	columnDefinitions.map((column) => ({
		...column,
		resizable: props.mode === 'width' && column.key !== 'id'
	}))
);
const columnLabels = new Map(columnDefinitions.map(({ key, label }) => [key, label]));
const orderSummary = computed(() =>
	props.mode === 'rows'
		? '当前项目顺序：' + rows.value.map((row) => row.id).join(' → ')
		: '当前列顺序：' + columnOrder.value.map((key) => columnLabels.get(key)).join(' → ')
);
const border = shallowRef(props.mode === 'width');
const widthChange = shallowRef('');
function showWidthChange(newWidth, oldWidth) {
	widthChange.value = `列宽已从 ${Math.round(oldWidth)} px 调整到 ${Math.round(newWidth)} px。`;
}
</script>

# AsamSortableTable 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

继续接入

快速开始 · 版本与迁移 · AI 开发说明

接口、行为与迁移细节

使用说明

行、单元格、批量编辑与原生拖拽/键盘排序复用列表控制器、字段定义和编辑写入协议。由应用注入保存与核实适配器，并持有 runtime/coordinator。

使用

完整普通 Vue SFC 见 tests/v2/table-editing/examples/EditingExample.vue。将字段、初始数据、校验规则与保存适配改为业务实际协议后使用。安装正常 @asam-ui/ui 与 @asam-ui/pro，引入两个包的 style.css；不需要额外拖拽引擎。控制器与列表应使用同一个 runtime。多实例使用同一个应用 coordinator。

useAsamTableEditing(config) 接收 list、runtime、coordinator、fields、save、saveOrder、confirmDiscard；可选 canWrite、equals、validate、verify、verifyOrder、onSaved。validate(model, keys, rowKey) 是明确声明的行级约束，cell 模式只传编辑字段的 keys。字段规则由真实 AsamForm 校验，未挂载校验器时拒绝发送；无 UI 使用者须 registerValidator 注册等价实际校验。

AsamEditableTable props：controller、columns、operationId(mode,key,field?)；可选 batchPatch、sortable、size。AsamSortableTable 同 props 并默认 sortable。operationId 必须由应用稳定保留，同一真实操作不能每次点击重新生成。新业务意图显式生成新标识。批量每行标识唯一。slots：toolbar({controller})、cell({row,column})、empty()。EditableTable expose：save()、cancel()、verify(key)。输入/结果均从 controller 读取；没有隐式 v-model 或组件保存事件，成功只通过 config.onSaved 交付一次。排序入口复用该视图，业务可直接使用 controller。

controller 公共状态：list、fields、entries、mode、order、rows、busy、writable、message。entry 含 key、operationId、只读 editor 视图、outcome（unsent/success/failure/unknown）、issues。编辑调用 controller.update，保存调用 controller.save；视图不公开内部 editor.submit，避免绕过整组预检。

两种视图均公开 save(): Promise<void>、cancel(): Promise<boolean>、verify(key): Promise<void>；组件 ref 使用 AsamEditableTableExpose / AsamSortableTableExpose。普通 SFC 的“退出编辑”演示由组件 ref 取消会话。权限撤回使草稿失效并显示只读状态。

缺属性与显式 undefined 在草稿和操作 input 中分别保留；按既有字段 transform 协议，undefined 不进入提交 payload。需要清空时根据字段类型明确使用 null、空串或空数组，不用 undefined 猜测后端清空语义。

四种模式

  • 行：open('row', [{key,operationId}])，选全部可编辑字段；原数据不突变，取消恢复读取视图。
  • 单元格：open('cell', targets, {field:'name'})，只校验/转换该字段和显式行约束，错误显示行与字段。
  • 批量：open('batch', targets, {patch:{name:''}})，固定目标与 patch，空对象表示没有编辑字段；缺属性和显式清空分别处理。拒绝隐藏、只读或禁用字段。整组校验与转换通过后逐行发送，成功项不重发；失败可修改重试；unknown 停止续发，先 verify 再显式保存剩余项。
  • 顺序：move(key,toKey,operationId) 修改当前排序投影，saveOrder 收到冻结的 before/next、scope 与稳定 operation。保存成功后宿主更新数据并 refresh；明确失败恢复 before 并保留 next 供重试；unknown 不宣称远端已回滚。原生拖拽手柄支持上下方向键，另有可访问上移/下移按钮。

失败、范围与生命周期

failure 必须表示服务确定未应用；断线、抛异常或无效结果视为 unknown。verify 仅接受已注入的业务核实接口；AbortSignal/关闭不代表撤销远端写。相同操作由既有 coordinator 防止重复写和重复 success。批量允许部分成功，不承诺数据库原子事务，不回滚已成功远端写。

同一 coordinator/scope 的这些编辑模式互斥；unknown 跨卸载保留 gate，重新打开同一 operationId 核实。不同范围不串状态。navigate(action) 在脏草稿离开前确认，拒绝则不运行 action。宿主翻页/排序/刷新应经该入口；外部强制变化会使旧会话失效，晚到结果只保留到 coordinator，不覆盖新页或触发旧 refresh。权限撤回也使旧会话失效。

活动中的 unknown 会话仍由原实例独占，其他实例只能在原会话关闭或卸载后恢复相同操作。operationId 同时绑定目标和行写/顺序写类型，不能跨类型复用，即使行 key 恰好是 order。异步校验完成后及每项真实适配器调用前都会重新核对当前目标 key；目标被原位移除/改 key 或排序基线改变时停止尚未发送的项，保留已发送操作的协调器结果。

排序只恢复本模块已记录为顺序写的既有操作。应用 coordinator 中来源未识别的现有记录，即使 target.id 为 order，也不能据此认定为顺序写；原编辑器创建的操作由原入口核实，新顺序意图使用新的 operationId。本模块拥有的顺序 unknown 在关闭/卸载后仍可由同 scope 新实例恢复核实，不重新发送。

key 为字符串或有限数字，0 与字符串0不同；缺失或重复 key 拒绝。只支持当前页受控平面结果集，不支持跨页、树形或虚拟行拖拽；全局排序合并由宿主处理。dispose 仅清理自身 editor/watch，不销毁宿主列表、runtime 或 coordinator。新模块无旧接口迁移；已有 AsamProTable 保持原协议。

表格行高用 tableSize=large/default/small/mini（60/50/42/36px），默认50px；size保留控件尺寸。普通空表体至少400px并使用公共空态。有列表控制器的兼容表/Host经原navigate守卫重新加载；受控行不制造读API。

完整类型

Types.ts · 完整类型
ts
import type { ComputedRef, Ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataRuntime, AsamRowKey, AsamRequestContext } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition, AsamFieldModel } from '../../fields/Types.js';
import type { AsamListController } from '../../list/Types.js';
import type {
	AsamEditIssue,
	AsamEditorConfig,
	AsamEditorController,
	AsamWriteOperation,
	AsamSaveResult
} from '../../editor/Types.js';

export type AsamTableEditMode = 'row' | 'cell' | 'batch' | 'order';
export interface AsamTableVerificationOutcome {
	readonly status: 'success' | 'not-applied' | 'unknown' | 'blocked' | 'cancelled';
}
export interface AsamTableEditTarget {
	readonly key: AsamRowKey;
	readonly operationId: string;
}
export interface AsamTableEditEntry extends AsamTableEditTarget {
	readonly editor: Pick<
		AsamEditorController,
		'fields' | 'model' | 'status' | 'issues' | 'message' | 'formatMessage' | 'dirty' | 'busy'
	>;
	readonly outcome: Readonly<Ref<'unsent' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'unknown'>>;
	readonly issues: Readonly<Ref<readonly AsamEditIssue[]>>;
}
export interface AsamOrderChange {
	readonly before: readonly AsamRowKey[];
	readonly next: readonly AsamRowKey[];
}
/** 应用持有 runtime/coordinator 和稳定 operationId；failure 表示确定未应用。 */
export interface AsamTableEditingConfig<Row extends object> {
	readonly list: AsamListController<Row>;
	readonly runtime: AsamDataRuntime;
	readonly coordinator: AsamEditorConfig['coordinator'];
	readonly fields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[];
	readonly canWrite?: () => boolean;
	readonly equals?: AsamEditorConfig['equals'];
	readonly save: AsamEditorConfig['save'];
	readonly verify?: AsamEditorConfig['verify'];
	readonly saveOrder: (
		change: AsamOrderChange,
		operation: AsamWriteOperation,
		context: AsamRequestContext
	) => Promise<AsamSaveResult>;
	readonly verifyOrder?: AsamEditorConfig['verify'];
	/** 行级约束；cell/batch 的 keys 只含明确编辑的字段。 */
	readonly validate?: (
		model: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
		keys: readonly string[],
		key: AsamRowKey
	) => Promise<readonly AsamEditIssue[]>;
	readonly confirmDiscard: () => Promise<boolean>;
	readonly onSaved?: AsamEditorConfig['onSaved'];
}
export interface AsamTableEditingController<Row extends object> {
	readonly list: AsamListController<Row>;
	readonly fields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[];
	readonly entries: Readonly<Ref<readonly AsamTableEditEntry[]>>;
	readonly mode: Readonly<Ref<AsamTableEditMode | null>>;
	readonly order: Readonly<Ref<readonly AsamRowKey[]>>;
	readonly rows: ComputedRef<readonly Row[]>;
	readonly busy: ComputedRef<boolean>;
	readonly writable: ComputedRef<boolean>;
	readonly message: Readonly<Ref<string>>;
	keyOf(row: Row): AsamRowKey;
	open(
		mode: 'row' | 'cell' | 'batch',
		targets: readonly AsamTableEditTarget[],
		options?: {
			readonly field?: string;
			readonly patch?: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>;
			/** 仅 row：显式开启多行各自完整初值/草稿；省略仍只接收一行。 */
			readonly multiple?: boolean;
		}
	): Promise<boolean>;
	update(key: AsamRowKey, field: string, value: unknown): boolean;
	registerValidator(
		key: AsamRowKey,
		validate: () => Promise<readonly AsamEditIssue[]>
	): () => void;
	save(): Promise<void>;
	verify(key: AsamRowKey): Promise<void>;
	/** Optional compatible host capabilities. Existing save/cancel/verify defaults stay unchanged. */
	saveRows?(keys: readonly AsamRowKey[]): Promise<void>;
	cancelRows?(keys: readonly AsamRowKey[]): Promise<boolean>;
	/** Authoritative coordinator conclusion, never inferred from a void verify return. */
	verifyResult?(key: AsamRowKey): Promise<AsamTableVerificationOutcome>;
	move(key: AsamRowKey, to: AsamRowKey, operationId: string): Promise<boolean>;
	cancel(): Promise<boolean>;
	/** 宿主翻页、排序等操作经此入口；拒绝丢弃时不执行 action。 */
	navigate(action: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<boolean>;
	dispose(): void;
}
